location_text: Outdoor restaurant table at San Pedro Square
summary: A diner's phone was grabbed from an outdoor table. The suspect fled on foot toward St. John Street; the victim was not injured.

location_text: From a bar in San Pedro Square toward a hotel lobby on Santa Clara Street
summary: A woman reported a man who had watched her in a bar followed her for several blocks after she left. She took refuge in a hotel lobby; no arrest has been made.

location_text: Near the San Pedro Square Market entrance
summary: A fight that began in a nearby bar spilled onto the sidewalk, leaving two men with minor injuries. One man was cited for battery.

location_text: St. James Park, cutting through toward 1st Street
summary: A student was verbally harassed and blocked from leaving by a group of three people. The student walked away toward 1st Street.

location_text: Near northeast corner of St. James Park, St. James and 3rd streets
summary: A cyclist was pushed off his bike, which was then taken, and he suffered scrapes. The suspect rode off toward Julian Street.

location_text: VTA light rail southbound on 2nd Street, getting off near Paseo de San Antonio (vague)
summary: A woman reported a man repeatedly touched her and made sexual comments on a light rail train. VTA is reviewing onboard camera footage.

location_text: Parking lot next to Diridon Station
summary: A car's rear window was smashed and a laptop and backpack were stolen. Police said vehicle break-ins near the station have been reported several times this month.
Several people reported a man approaching pedestrians and demanding money over the past few weeks, mostly at night. Police have received a handful of calls but no confirmed location.

location_text: St. James Park near North 3rd Street
summary: A woman's purse was grabbed from her shoulder. The suspect ran north on 3rd Street and the woman was not hurt.

location_text: North 3rd Street edge of St. James Park
summary: A man walking along the park was punched by a stranger and treated for a bloody nose. The attacker left on foot and has not been identified.

location_text: From light rail toward St. James Park along North 3rd Street, ending at 3rd and St. James streets
summary: A woman reported a man followed her and kept pace with her along North 3rd Street. She called police and the man walked away before officers arrived.

location_text: St. James Park near North 3rd Street
summary: A group of men shouted at two students, made crude comments and tried to block their path. The students crossed the street and reported it to campus police.

location_text: Santa Clara Street light rail stop on 2nd Street
summary: A rider's phone was snatched from his hand while he waited at the stop. The suspect ran east on Santa Clara Street.

location_text: Light rail platform on 2nd Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: A man stood close to a woman, made sexual comments and would not leave her alone. VTA security escorted her onto the next train.

location_text: Light rail stop on 2nd Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: An argument turned into a fight, leaving one person with minor injuries. Police detained one man at the scene.

location_text: Light rail stop on 1st Street at Santa Clara Street
summary: A backpack containing a laptop was taken from a bench while its owner looked at the train schedule. Police are reviewing nearby camera footage.
